input.summary: Convert the §2 grant into a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Work, conform the §3(c) sublicence bar, and limit Garman's use of our data to providing the services.
input.comment: [Playbook] Garman keeps ownership of the Work, but we need the fallback licence position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free right to use, modify and sublicense the Work for our business, so we have conformed the sublicence restriction in Section 3(c) and the location/extra-fee limits that contradict it. We have also confirmed that any licence to Garman in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.
